articles.summary: PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems and aftermarket solutions, announced today that it will participate in the Stephens Annual Investment Conference on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. Conference participation will be in-person and include a QA session to discuss dynamics across the various markets PHINIA serves around the world and the Company’s business. PHINIA’s President and CEO, Brady Ericson, and Senior VP and ​CFO, Chris Gropp, will participate in investor meetings and a fireside chat moderated by Jeff Lick, managing director and research analyst at Stephens. The event will be webcast and available on PHINIA’s Investor Relations website . Event information can be found below. Event Title: Stephens Annual Investment Conference | NASH2026 Event Date: Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 12:45 PM Eastern Standard Time (11:45 AM Central Standard Time) Live Webcast Info:
